GRAYSCALE.EnabledHint: Desaturates the interface, map, tokens and images for all users.
GRAYSCALE.SaturationHint: 0 = full grayscale. 100 = normal colors. Default for all users.
GRAYSCALE.OverrideHint: Overrides the GM value, for you only.
GRAYSCALE.UserSaturationHint: Only used if "Use my own saturation" is checked.
GRAYSCALE.KeepColorLightHint: The area lit by this light stays in color despite the grayscale.
GRAYSCALE.KeepColorTokenHint: This token stays in color despite the grayscale.
GRAYSCALE.ColorRadiusHint: In scene distance units. 0 = the token only.
